annotations.text: A · FELT & GOLD — deep felt, gold foil, serif display. The safest casino read; also the most expected.
B · NEON NOIR — midnight blue and magenta glow, mono numerals, neon flicker. Striking; glow fights dense score tables.
C · HIGH ROLLER — black and signal red, oversized type, marquee bulbs. Loudest and most confident; least cosy.
D · DECO BRASS — art-deco symmetry, brass linework, Roman numerals. Most characterful; ornament costs vertical space.
E · SUIT MOTIF — the four tiles ARE the suits, tiles deal in like cards. Light theme; the outlier of the set.
F · VELVET MINIMAL — velvet plum and champagne, restrained motion. Best for reading scores fast; least loud.
